name: Zoji-la Tunnel
facts: Zoji-La Tunnel, the world’s longest single‑tube bi‑directional road tunnel, stretches 13.153 km at an altitude of 11,578 ft, cutting travel between Sonamarg and Dras from four hours to just 40 minutes.
After IL&FS collapsed in 2019, Megha Engineering & Infrastructure Ltd. took over in 2020, and by May 2026 excavation was only 140 m from breakthrough, keeping the February 2028 opening on schedule.

Designed as a smart tunnel, it will feature transverse ventilation, CCTV, emergency phones every 125 m, and pedestrian cross‑passages every 250 m, ensuring safety in this high‑altitude Himalayan passage.
